items.title: OF21_Response_200_Offers

all_prices.description:
All prices for the offer
For Dropship specifically: the list of purchasing prices of the offer, also referred to as costs or wholesale prices

items.title: OF21_Response_200_Offers_AllPrices

channel_code.description:
Single Channel Pricing users: The channel code on which a specific price applies.
    This is the pricing_channel_code supplied as input in the API if prices are defined for this channel.
    If no pricing is defined for this channel, or no pricing_channel_code is supplied, it falls back on the default prices.
    channel_code is set to null for the default prices. Multi Channel Pricing users: returned null.
    Refer to context > channel_codes in order to retrieve the channel codes for which the price apply.

discount_end_date.description: End date of the discount, or null if no discount exists or if the discount does not have an end date.

discount_start_date.description: Start date of the discount, or null if no discount exists or if the discount does not have a start date.

price.description:
Price of the offer.
For Dropship specifically: the purchasing price of the offer
If a discount is defined and is currently active (within the validity interval), it represents the unit_discount_price.
In other cases, it represents the unit_origin_price.

unit_discount_price.description:
Discount price for a quantity of one, i.e. the discount price for a quantity of one.
For Dropship specifically: the discount purchasing price for a quantity of one
Set to null if no discount is defined or if no discount price for a quantity of one is defined.

unit_origin_price.description:
Original price for a quantity of one, i.e. the price for a quantity of one regardless of the discounts.
For Dropship specifically: the purchasing price for a quantity of one, also referred to as cost or wholesale price

volume_prices.description: Volume prices for each quantity threshold. Returns at least the price for a quantity threshold of one.

items.description: Price configuration and discount schedule applied to specific contexts or quantity tiers.

allow_quote_requests.description: Whether the offer is eligible for quotation

inactivity_reasons.description: Reasons for offers inactivity, mandatory if an offer is inactive

internal_description.description: The offer's description as shown in the back office

leadtime_to_ship.description: Offer's lead time to ship value. If this value has been set to 0, value is returned as 1 (unless platform's default lead time to ship value is also 0). If no lead time to ship was specified for the offer, platform's default value is returned.

price.description:
Retail price of the offer, also referred to as selling price.
If a discount is defined and is currently active (within the validity interval), it represents the unit_discount_price.
In other cases, it represents the unit_origin_price.

Discount retail price for a quantity of one, i.e. the discount retail price for a quantity of one.
Set to null if no discount is defined or if no discount retail price for a quantity of one is defined or if the discount is not currently active (within the validity interval).

shipping_deadline.description: Estimated shipping date, that includes business closing days and cut-off configured on the platform. Add the earliest and latest delivery times to calculate the estimated delivery date to customers

total_price.description:
Total price of the offer (price + minimum shipping rate)
For Dropship specifically: the purchasing price of the offer + minimum shipping rate

warehouses.description: The breakdown of the available quantities of the offer in each warehouse.
